{{Quote|Well, there's a picture, finally, but I'm not trusting the witnesses. I mean, come on! How can ''he'' be the "Corellian Strangler"? You'd hear him splashing around before he snuck up on you!|Krav Noblis, on the individual's alleged identity as "Kelven Garnatrope"|<ref name="tools" />}}
An '''individual''' happened to be in the [[Upper City]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] at the time when [[Zayne Carrick]] was being taken to the [[Jedi Tower]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Valius Ying]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="Kotor">[[Knights of the Old Republic 6|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 6]]</ref> At one point around [[3963 BBY]], a picture of the individual<ref name="JJM">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor47.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #47''}}</ref> appeared in "Krav's Hot List", a column in ''[[The Adjudicator]]'' [[Holofeed/Legends|Holofeed]] written by the [[Journalist/Legends|editor]] [[Krav Noblis]],<ref name="outerrim">{{KOTORbackups|14}}</ref> as the alleged identity of the "[[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Toki Tollivar|Strangler]]" with four [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] "totaling 43,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]" being posted.<ref name="tools" /> In his listing, Noblis doubted that the individual<ref name="JJM" /> actually was "Kelven Garnatrope" and mockingly suggested that the individual<ref name="JJM" /> would be heard "splashing around before he" could sneak up on anyone.<ref name="tools" /> The following report of ''[[The Adjudicator]]'' used a [[Unidentified individual (The Adjudicator)|different individual]]'s picture.<ref name="colonies">{{KOTORbackups|23}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For the third time in the series, we have a perp-walk as we did on Taris — and while we didn’t really have room in #24 to mimic what we did in #6, this time, we had the artist who drew the page, originally, to recraft the scene. Zayne and Gryph stand right where Shel and Shad did. I only wish we’d found a spot for Fish-bowl Guy!|John Jackson Miller|<ref name="JJM" />}}
The individual was drawn by [[Brian Ching]] and [[Michael Atiyeh]] for the [[Knights of the Old Republic 6|sixth installment]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] written by [[John Jackson Miller]], which was the final part of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Commencement|''Commencement'']] story arc.<ref name="Kotor" /> On his "Faraway Press" blog, Miller described the character as "the fish-bowl guy at the far left of the opening spread".<ref name="first">{{Faraway|url=comics/starwarsknightsoftheoldrepublic/starwarsknightsoftheoldrepublic6/|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #6''}}</ref> On a later blog post, Miller stated that he wished they "found a spot for '''Fish-bowl Guy'''" in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 47|first issue]] of the story arc [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Demon|''Demon'']].<ref name="JJM" />
